evidence.excerpt: The grammar is bidirectional and can also turn an MRS back into an English sentence. \citet{hajdik2019} used the ERG's treebank to build a benchmark for that generation task, MRS to text, and trained sequence-to-sequence models to solve it.

evidence.excerpt: We reconstruct their 10K-sentence test split, and score two large language models, Claude Sonnet~4.5 and Claude Opus~5, in both directions against their trained systems and against ACE, with no task-specific training.
